verdict.rationale: Docs mention 'observability' only as a bullet-point topic in the production hosting guide, with no concrete UI, dashboard, or trace visualization shown; hooks provide programmatic callbacks on tool/session events that a developer could wire into their own tracing, but that's not a built-in observability UI. Hands-on community feedback directly contradicts any claim of a usable trace UI, describing the harness as offering '0 observability' and being 'garbage when it comes at displaying full details of tool calls and session management'. missing for 10: a documented first-party observability/tracing UI, screenshots or docs of a trace viewer, and independent confirmation it works well (current hands-on evidence says the opposite).
